title: Dangerous Goods Acceptance: Amount of the Amendment Fee Due
content:
## Clause

The amendment fee due on a Dangerous Goods Acceptance file at the moment of handling is the tariff fee for an unsettled chargeable amendment, but only where the acceptance is open (submitted, under review or approved) and the booking is in a pre-loading status (requested, confirmed, equipment released or gated in). If either status test fails, the amount due is 0.00, even where an unsettled chargeable amendment exists. Where no chargeable amendment is unsettled, the tariff fee itself is 0.00.

The amount is a whole tariff figure stated to two decimal places; no further rounding is applied to it.

## Truth table

| Unsettled chargeable amendment | Acceptance open | Booking in a pre-loading status | Amount due |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | yes | the category's amendment fee |
| yes | yes | no | 0.00 |
| yes | no | yes | 0.00 |
| yes | no | no | 0.00 |
| no | any | any | 0.00 |

## Scope of this rule

This rule fixes the amount only. The conditions that the amendment itself has to meet — the amendment deadline counted from the cargo cut-off, the ceiling on signed amendments, the permitted change of weight, the permitted rise in containers and the customer's allotment on the sailing — keep governing both the signed amendment and the fee it gives rise to, exactly as they stand; nothing here adds to them.
